cases.question: As of now, what is the tax-free income threshold for an ordinary resident individual in Bangladesh? State the applicable assessment year and cite the operative schedule.

items.content: As of now, what is the tax-free income threshold for an ordinary resident individual in Bangladesh? State the applicable assessment year and cite the operative schedule.

For an ordinary resident individual, the tax-free threshold is **Tk 400,000** for **assessment year 2026–2027**. The applicable rate schedule in **Schedule 2 of the Finance Act, 2026**, as described in the NBR’s *Income Tax Paripatra 2026–27*, sets the first Tk 400,000 of total income at a 0% rate. [1]

cases.question: Under the Companies Act 1994 in this corpus, when should a company hold its first annual general meeting, and what is the maximum interval between subsequent AGMs? Cite the section.

items.content: Under the Companies Act 1994 in this corpus, when should a company hold its first annual general meeting, and what is the maximum interval between subsequent AGMs? Cite the section.

A company must hold its first AGM within 18 months of incorporation. After that, the interval between one AGM and the next must not exceed 15 months. These rules are in section 81(1) of the Companies Act 1994. [1]

The reviewed evidence does not establish the operative duty to deduct tax on office-premises rent or the applicable 2026 withholding rate or table.
